reason: My quotes are my business. I'm not handing my price list and my buyers' enquiries to a remote studio that has one chemical website to show and is offering discounts for case studies. Rs 5,000 every month on top of 60,000 for something my son can do in Excel and WhatsApp is also not small for me.
objection: If this small studio shuts down or stops answering the phone after six months, who runs my quote desk and who has my price list? Then I am stuck paying monthly for a system nobody maintains.
would_change_my_mind: Let me talk to that chemical-trading client and see their quote desk working on real IndiaMART enquiries, and put it in writing that the code and my data are handed to me if you close. Then I will still get two other quotes and bargain the setup down.
